notes:
Snapshot of CRM notes and negotiation items:
- Customer profile: mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B). Heavy real-time chat support + in-app semantic search. High cost sensitivity but cannot compromise latency for enterprise customers.
- Technical: currently prototyping on Hosted API. POC validated functional parity. Key metrics: baseline ~200k tokens/day (current), expecting ramp to 800k tokens/day in 9 months as feature rolls out; peak/day bursts up to ~1.6M tokens on marketing days. Target p95 latency <= 350ms for typical chat sessions (trim long contexts).
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 compliance, KMS integration; audit logs and 18 month retention for support transcripts. EU data residency for subset of customers (want Redwood Private or Dedicated with region pinning).
- Dedicated ask: pricing/packaging discussion focused on commit levels + burst/overage mechanics. Customer proposal: 12-month commited baseline equivalent to 600k tokens/day with ability to burst up to 2.5x baseline. Requests: capped overage rate at 1.2x committed unit price, and a 3-month ramp (50% month1, 75% month2, 100% month3) to accommodate adoption. Also seeking 10% discount for annual prepay, and a 6-month free burst buffer during ramp.
- Redwood counter-proposal (verbal): three tier commit bands (400k, 600k, 1M tokens/day) with negotiated overage at 1.5x unit rate; burst allowance = 1.5x baseline for short windows (configurable), and a 3-quarter ramp schedule (Q1:50%, Q2:75%, Q3:100%) if committed annually. Proposed to include one-time migration credit and 30-day free burst trial.
- Acceptance criteria for Dedicated POC: sustained p95 latency <= 350ms at target concurrency (50 concurrent chats) for 72 hours; KV/prefix cache hit rate >60% for repeat queries; cost model validated against 3-week production traffic sample.
- Internal stakeholders: Product (CTO Petra Luo), Infra Lead (Ben Holloway), Procurement (Anita Singh). Petra pushing for Dedicated due to predictable SLAs; Procurement pushing back on multi-year lock.
- Quotes & docs: pricing-deck-v3, security-faq-v2 shared in drive. Legal opened review ticket (SEC-78).
